title: K-flat comparison of the actual support sequences
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow P$, $j:U\hookrightarrow P$ be a closed-open pair of schemes and let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Work on ordinary small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $T_W=-\otimes_A^LB_W$ and let $\operatorname{Res}$ be exact restriction of scalars [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Suppose $L\in D(P_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $TL$ and $Rj_*j^*TL$ are bounded below, and so are $L$, $Rj_*j^*L$ and $T_PRj_{*,A}j^*L$. Choose a degreewise-injective K-injective representative $I$ of $L$, a K-flat flat-term resolution $Q\to B_P$, and a functorial degreewise-injective K-injective replacement $a:N=\operatorname{Tot}(Q\otimes_A I)\to J$ [lem-pc-kflat-resolution, lem-pur-kinjective-degreewise-existence]. Let $H_A$ and the actual short exact support sequences be those of [lem-pur-etale-injective-support-sequence]. Tensoring the support sequence of $I$ with $Q$ gives a degreewise short exact sequence. There is a natural map from this sequence to the support sequence of $J$ whose middle map is $a$ and whose last map is
$$Q\otimes_A j_*j^*I\to j_*(j^*Q\otimes_A j^*I)\xrightarrow{j_*j^*a}j_*j^*J.$$
Its first map is the induced map of kernels. The resulting morphism of distinguished triangles has middle map the identity of $\operatorname{Res}(TL)$ and right map the restriction of the canonical coefficient projection $T_PRj_{*,A}j^*L\to Rj_{*,B}j^*TL$. In particular, if that right map is invertible, its first map is invertible. These claims include compatibility with the connecting arrow and do not impose a strict $B$-module structure on $Q$.

proof.text: The strict support comparison gives the actual short exact rows, their unique characterized morphism, its naturality, and invertibility of its localized middle map. This is independent of scalar extension.

Apply the separately normalized open quotient comparison to identify its canonical third component with the restricted coefficient projection. The middle normalization follows by cancellation of the localized augmentation with its inverse in replacementIso. Combine these assertions with the strict diagram.

Apply triangleOfSES to the two short exact rows and their strict map. Its distinguishedness and boundary naturality give the distinguished triangles and connecting square. The localized middle map is invertible; apply the triangle two-isomorphism lemma when the third map is invertible.

theorem etale_kflat_support_comparison [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (i : Z ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ P) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ)
    (L : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (_hTL : ∃ n : ℤ, ((scalarExtension φ P).obj L.obj).IsGE n)
    (_hRTL : ∃ n : ℤ, ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j)).obj
      ((D(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j)).obj
        ((scalarExtension φ P).obj L.obj))).IsGE n)
    (_hRL : ∃ n : ℤ, ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj
      ((D(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj L.obj)).IsGE n)
    (_hTRL : ∃ n : ℤ, ((scalarExtension φ P).obj
      ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj
        ((D(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj L.obj))).IsGE n)
    (I : Complex A P) [I.IsKInjective] [∀ n : ℤ, Injective (I.X n)]
    (e : (localize A P).obj I ≅ L.obj)
    (Q : Complex A P)
    (π : Q ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (Sheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) 0).obj (scalarCoefficientSheaf φ P))
    [QuasiIso π] (hQ : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso
      (Sheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ)).kFlat Q)
    (_hQf : ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (Q.X n))
    (F : Complex A P ⥤ Complex A P) (η : 𝟭 _ ⟶ F)
    [∀ K : Complex A P, (F.obj K).IsKInjective]
    [∀ (K : Complex A P) (n : ℤ), Injective ((F.obj K).X n)]
    [∀ K : Complex A P, QuasiIso (η.app K)] :
    let S := (topSequenceFamily A i j hij Q).obj I
    let N := Q ⊗ I
    let _J := F.obj N
    let a := η.app N
    let S' := (bottomSequenceFamily A i j hij Q F).obj I
    let v := OpenSupport.rightMap
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)
      Q I (F.obj (Q ⊗ I)) (η.app (Q ⊗ I))
    ∃ (hI : CochainComplex.IsKInjective
        ((pullComplex A j).obj I))
      (hJ : CochainComplex.IsKInjective
        ((pullComplex A j).obj (F.obj (Q ⊗ I))))
      (hTop : S.ShortExact)
      (hBottom : S'.ShortExact)
      (m : S ⟶ S'),
      HEq m.τ₂ a ∧
      HEq m.τ₃ v ∧
      (∀ m' : S ⟶ S',
        HEq m'.τ₂ a →
        HEq m'.τ₃ v → m' = m) ∧
      _root_.DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES hTop ∈ distTriang _ ∧
      _root_.DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES hBottom ∈ distTriang _ ∧
      _root_.DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ hTop ≫
          ((localize A P).map m.τ₁)⟦1⟧' =
        (localize A P).map m.τ₃ ≫ _root_.DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ hBottom ∧
      (tensorModel φ Q π hQ I L.obj e).inv ≫ (localize A P).map (η.app (Q ⊗ I)) ≫
          (replacementIso (η.app (Q ⊗ I)) (tensorModel φ Q π hQ I L.obj e)).hom =
        𝟙 _ ∧
      (localize A P).map v ≫
          (targetThirdModel φ j (F.obj (Q ⊗ I)) L.obj
            (replacementIso (η.app (Q ⊗ I)) (tensorModel φ Q π hQ I L.obj e)) hJ).hom =
        (sourceThirdModel φ j Q π hQ I L.obj e hI).hom ≫ restrictedProjection φ j L.obj ∧
      (IsIso ((localize A P).map m.τ₃) → IsIso ((localize A P).map m.τ₁)) ∧
      DiagramNatural (topSequenceFamily A i j hij Q)
        (bottomSequenceFamily A i j hij Q F)
        (IsComparison A i j hij Q F η) I m
